URL: https://media.rac.co.uk/price-of-diesel-reaches-record-high
Outlet: RAC Media Centre, published 28/09/2026 (NOTE: six weeks old — background only, not current prices)

Price of diesel reaches record high

Key Price Figures
- Diesel: 199.18p per litre (record high)
- Petrol (Unleaded): 174.13p per litre
- Cost to fill average family car (diesel): approximately £110
- Cost to fill average family car (petrol): approximately £96

Price Changes Since 28/02/2026:
- Petrol: +41.3p (+31.1%)
- Diesel: +56.8p (+39.9%)

RAC head of policy Simon Williams stated: "The average price of a litre of diesel has now reached the highest level in UK history at 199.18p, in what will be a financial blow to households and businesses that use their vehicles regularly."

He further noted that "only a sustained lower oil price – over several weeks, not days – will lead to cheaper prices at the pumps" and advocated that "the Government could take steps to ease the burden on drivers by lowering fuel duty further or reducing VAT."
